overview: Nlock'i is a full-featured fitness and nutrition tracking web app with social features. Track daily workouts with a 111-exercise library organized in weekly schedules, log meals using ready-made food lists or barcode scanning, monitor macros and water intake, set goals, view progress charts, and connect with people through a social feed with direct messaging.
features: Daily fitness log with 111+ categorized exercises and weekly Mon-Sun schedule with editable weights
Nutrition tracking with ready-made food presets, portion options, macro bars, and water quick-add
Open Food Facts barcode scanning for packaged food nutrition data
Goal setting with real-time progress rings and achievement badges on dashboard
Progress charts (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly) for workouts, calories, macros, and water
Social feed with posts, stories, likes, comments, follow system, and public/private profiles
Direct messaging with inbox, pending requests tab, and message request flow
Data export as CSV for nutrition and fitness logs
Profile photo upload and customizable user profiles
Internet Identity authentication with dark/light mode and pink accent branding
